packages.identity: LangChain OpenWiki CLI and Pi integration
packages.registry_metadata_query: npm view openwiki@0.7.2 name version license repository.url engines node peerDependencies pi --json

integration_contract.transport: local child process running package CLI with mcp --host pi over stdio
integration_contract.writes: repository wiki lifecycle may write pages, indexes, provenance and setup metadata; personal/connectors mode writes under OpenWiki home

packages.telemetry_assessment: Official README documents default-on aggregate openwiki_run telemetry for standalone init/update; documented opt-outs are OPENWIKI_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1. Integration itself delegates to mcp --host pi and does not call the telemetry sender directly in inspected file. Exact installed-build host-driven egress remains unverified.
packages.behavioral_test: not run; suitable only for provider-free API smoke test followed by isolated synthetic writer test

limitations: Installed file hashes record the current local files; the npm lock SRI records expected archive integrity, but this audit did not download and re-hash registry tarballs.
No provider or network behavior was exercised.
Wildcard Pi SDK peers and matching method names are not runtime compatibility proof.
No claim of sandboxing or complete transitive dependency audit is made.
